component.name: Linux64Studio
component.summary: Write, build and debug Commodore 64 programs

description.p: A Commodore 64 development environment, modelled on CBM prg Studio, built so the Retro Game Dev C64 Edition books can be followed on Linux. Its assembler accepts CBM prg Studio's syntax exactly, and it builds Kick Assembler, BASIC V2 and C (cc65) projects too.

ul.li: Source-level debugging in VICE: breakpoints, stepping, registers, memory, snapshots
A profiler and exact routine timing, and transcripts that test routines in VICE
Sprite, character set and screen editors, SID sound design and GoatTracker music
Disk images, cartridges, and step-by-step tutorials

description.p: VICE, and cc65 for C, are installed separately, outside the Flatpak: sudo apt install vice cc65
